name: Premium Teardrop Flags
descriptionHtml:
Promote your brand with confidence using our Premium Teardrop Flags, designed for dynamic visibility at trade shows, outdoor events, storefronts, festivals, and vendor booths. The teardrop shape maintains its form even in windy conditions, keeping your message clean, readable, and eye-catching at all times.

Available in 8ft, 10ft, and 14ft sizes, all teardrop flags are double-sided by default, ensuring your branding is visible from both directions. Your artwork is printed using high-resolution full-color dye sublimation on premium knitted polyester fabric for vibrant colors and long-lasting durability.

Each flag comes standard with a cross base and water bag, making it ideal for both indoor and outdoor environments. For added flexibility, you may upgrade to ground stakes or a canopy mounting kit, allowing the flag to be securely mounted directly to a canopy tent.

Built with strong yet flexible fiberglass poles, these flags are lightweight, durable, and easy to assemble—perfect for vendors who demand performance and professional presentation.

🔹 Key Features

🚩 Teardrop Flag Design – Aerodynamic shape for stability and visibility
📏 Available Sizes – 8ft, 10ft, and 14ft
🔁 Double-Sided Printing Included – Standard on all flags
🎨 Full-Color Dye Sublimation – Sharp, fade-resistant graphics
💪 Fiberglass Poles – Lightweight, flexible, and durable
⚓ Base Included – Cross base + water bag included
🏕️ Multiple Mounting Options – Optional ground stakes or canopy mounting kit
🧳 Portable & Easy Setup – Ideal for events, promotions, and displays

🔹 Imprint Method

🖨️ Full-Color Dye Sublimation

🔹 Materials

🧵 Graphic / Flag: Knitted Polyester
🦾 Hardware: 100% Epoxy Fiberglass
🎒 Carry Case: 600 Denier Polyester

🔹 Primary Usage

Trade shows, outdoor events, vendor booths, canopy tents, storefront advertising, festivals, promotions, and brand activations.

Warranty

We stand behind the quality of our products. Our warranty covers any factory defects or damage that occurs during shipping. However, please note that we do not cover damage resulting from extreme weather conditions, misuse, or any circumstances beyond our control.
